notes.title: Patch 1.03 - 12/19
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

It's been a while since our last patch, thank you for sticking with us!
Here are the patch notes:

1.      Added support for NVidia VRWorks, optimizing performance for GeForce GTX 900 series, Quadro M5000 graphic cards and above.
2.      Added support for Oculus Touch controller Hand gestures. 

Thank you for playing Unearthing Mars!

--Unearthing Mars Team

notes.title: Patch 1.02 - 6/30
notes.content:
Hi! For people who are having trouble with player height in game, we have added a new feature:

- Added height reset feature on HTC Vive controller's top button above the round pad. 

We want to thank everyone for your support and feedback, again. Hope you have a great weekend!

notes.title: Patch 1.01 - 6/27
notes.content:
Patch 1.01 - 6/27

Hi everyone! First of all, we would like to thank our community for every support and the reviews you have provided. With your help, we found some issues and have successfully managed to fix them. Here's the patch note:

1. Fixed some flickering bugs
2. Fixed some visual bugs
3. Fixed minor audio issue of Chapter 1
4. Fixed background music issue of Chapter 2
5. Fixed some controller vibration issues
6. Adjusted settings for gun holding
7. Performance slightly optimized

Note：You can play this game either completely seated, or completely standing.

Again, thank you all for the support. Feel free to leave a comment if you are having any kind of trouble in the game. We are happy to hear your feedback.

tags.bug: 3. Fixed minor audio issue of Chapter 1
4. Fixed background music issue of Chapter 2
